does.text: Keeps one singleton marker entity for 'photo mode is active'. When an entity got both the DoF and FoV photo-mode components this frame (Added query with two add-ands) and no ls::photo_mode::ActivatedComponent is alive (Persistent query empty), it creates a new entity through the deferred command buffer and adds ActivatedComponent to it (the helper is AddComponent<ls::photo_mode::ActivatedComponent>: it sets up frame storage for that type index and returns it). Only in a frame with no such add, when the removed-DoF/FoV queries have any hit, it looks up the Activated singleton and destroys its entity when found. ProcessPhotoModeSessions uses the same query slots.
